name: Sneasel
description: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Ice Shard
moves.description: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This raises the user’s offensive stats.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the target. This may also leave the target with frostbite.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.description: The target is punched with an icy fist. This may also leave the target with frostbite.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target with frostbite.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user restores its own HP but also becomes drowsy.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air.

moves.name: False Swipe
moves.description: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target to deal damage. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This attack never misses.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: The user strikes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Shadow Claw
moves.description: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Psycho Cut
moves.description: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.description: The user attacks by crying out as if it's ranting about something. This also lowers the target's offensive stats.
